title: Green Account (savings) specifications and requirements
summary: This document lists Green Account (savings) specifications: $100 minimum opening deposit, $500 ongoing minimum balance, up to 8 free withdrawals per month, and daily interest compounding. It also requires paperless statements (Yes) and notes the debit card is made from recycled ocean plastic (Yes).
